title: Follow-up checkup reminder
description: Prompt patients to schedule a follow-up or annual checkup. Re-engagement WhatsApp template for clinics. Free to copy and edit.
notes: This is a proactive nudge, so classify it as marketing and include opt-out. Refer to the service type without medical detail.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, it's time for your yearly checkup at {{clinic}}. Booking takes under a minute, and slots with {{doctor}} are open next week.
